items.text:
Boarded a large, derelict ship
Got jumped by a gang of pirates living there
Should probably factory reset my door to set a security pin

Reload save and go to another ship
Find $50k worth of salvage
Cha-ching
Rip the seats out of my ship for more storage
Loaded the salvage
Conduit blew and I suffocated before I could fix it
Should probably carry quick-place emergency conduit

Reload save and do it again
O2 sensor starts going haywire
Atmosphere quickly dissipating
Die again

Reload save and realize I covered my O2 sensor with salvage

This game is amazing. I give it a 7/10 because of the woke pronoun garbage. If it wasnt for the woke stuff, I wouldve given it a 10/10. The game is good enough that Im willing to ignore it. Usually I dont.
items.text_zh:
登上了一艘巨大、废弃的飞船
被住在那里的一帮海盗伏击了
大概应该把我的门恢复出厂设置来设置一个安全密码

重新读档，去另一艘船
找到价值5万美元的 salvage
叮叮叮（钱到账的声音）
把我飞船上的座椅拆掉以增加存储空间
装上了 salvage
导管爆了，我还没来得及修就窒息死了
大概应该随身携带快速放置的应急导管

重新读档，再来一次
氧气传感器开始发疯
大气迅速消散
又死了

重新读档，然后意识到我把氧气传感器用 salvage 盖住了

这游戏太棒了。我给它打7/10，因为那些觉醒代词垃圾。要不是那些觉醒玩意儿，我会给它打10/10。这游戏好到让我愿意忽略它。通常我不会。

observations.description: O2传感器被杂物覆盖导致死亡
observations.evidence: realize I covered my O2 sensor with salvage
observations.evidence_zh: 意识到我把O2传感器用打捞物盖住了
